text:
mike_revenueops: Heads-up: noticed invoice INV-2026-0917 charged BrightEdge partner at a flat legacy rate instead of the tiered ladder. Looks like a mapping miss. :frowning:

emma_finance: Can you drop the invoice snippet and partner id?

mike_revenueops: Partner: BrightEdge Resellers (CH-998). Invoice lines:
```
INV-2026-0917 | SKU: BR-LEG-XL | Usage: 180000 units | Rate applied: $0.03/unit | Amount: $5400.00
Expected tiers -> 0-50k @ $0.05, 50k-150k @ $0.035, 150k+ @ $0.02 -> expected amount ~$3200.00
```

raj_billing: running quick query against billing mediation. shows applied_tier = NULL, applied_rate = 0.03. Looks like sku_tier_map uses migrated key BR-LEG-XL-v1 still.

billingbot: Invoice INV-2026-0917 created by billing-pipeline v2.3.9 at 2026-04-02T14:05:12Z. No tier rule matched.

sofia_ops: That explains it. Migration script renamed SKUs but didn't add aliases. We should add alias rows for backwards compat. Also add unit test for tier lookup.

emma_finance: Finance will need the credit calculation and GL. Mike, propose amount and GL code?

mike_revenueops: Proposed credit = $5400.00 - $3200.00 = $2200.00. GL: 4330 (Customer Credits - Marketplace).

raj_billing: I'll add an adjustment row to billing-reconcile sheet and attach query outputs + billingbot log. Will also open an engineering ticket (ENGOPS-4821) for mapping fix.

sofia_ops: Suggest we don't issue the credit until we confirm with AWS Marketplace support that their meter reports align. I'll create the support case and reference INV-2026-0917.

emma_finance: Agreed. I'll prepare a draft credit memo and queue for manager approval. If AWS confirms their side is clean, we proceed to credit $2,200. Otherwise hold.

mike_revenueops: Thanks all. Ping me when the sheet and ticket are up. :white_check_mark:

raj_billing: Sheet row added: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED. ENGOPS-4821 created.

emma_finance: Manager approved provisional credit path pending AWS confirmation. Will post final here after support reply.

sofia_ops: Filed follow-up for adding SKU aliasing + deploy test before next billing window.

billingbot: Support case AWS-125987 opened referencing invoice INV-2026-0917.
